gen-gf-cambo-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera spreads out in plain sans lines drawn like a plotter pen. Cambo, the serif up top, has a brush-stroke softness and slightly thinner hairlines, so a long run of the wide, unshaded body settles into a steady, open rhythm.
gen-gf-cambo-gf-lexend-zetta: Approachable and widely tracked, Lexend Zetta carries the text in sans strokes cut like ribbon. And Cambo earns its place on big, short lines, where its gradual weight change and traditional editorial feel get room to show.
gen-gf-cambo-gf-montserrat-alternates: Cambo's small letters are thick with height, like bundled cable. Montserrat Alternates follows in plain sans with a wide-open c and strokes that trace one thick thread; make the heading noticeably larger.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-author: Author reads with a refined, dignified hush, its bowls swelling only slightly. Castoro Titling is the loud one, bold uprights beside scratch-thin horizontals, while Author keeps its thick-thin variation low-key and comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-fs-karma: Karma reads like a trustworthy, classic serif with barely any gap between x-height and caps. Castoro Titling brings bold verticals and whisper-thin horizontals, and Karma's restrained stems and connecting strokes keep the page from getting loud.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-fs-literata: Castoro Titling puts a heavy stem beside a hair-thin arm, and the effect is dramatic and unmistakable. Shrink it, and those hairlines fade; Literata's soft shifts hold up at any size.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-fs-sentient: Fat downstrokes, threadlike upstrokes: Castoro Titling looks like a broad-nib pen caught mid-flourish, while Sentient's pinched apertures and slightly finer crossbars stay sophisticated and contemporary. Their strongest quality is this sharp, dignified difference, better for brief copy.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-gf-bhutuka-expand: Castoro Titling swells and thins like a pointed steel nib. BhuTuka Expanded One answers in a serif with marker-tip lines and curvy, unclamped letters, slowing the pace to a leisurely, literary walk beneath the headline's drama.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads bookish and dignified, with open counters breathing into the white space and no thick-thin shifts at all. Words stretch out leisurely, so Castoro Titling's feather-light hairlines would feel far away.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-gf-kiwi-maru: Castoro Titling pairs heavy stems with delicate hairline serifs, an unmistakably commanding look. Kiwi Maru then reads in generous letterspace, its o a ring with a constant wall, so pages feel traditional and unhurried.
